19.text: Nvidia fell over 25% in 30 days despite record results, with analysts divided and price targets cut (Needham to $200, fair value to $319.99). Wedbush expects Nvidia to beat quarterly revenue estimates, while commentary cites a leadership change and an ongoing investigation.

22.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned after reports of two extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China; CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO. The board had prepared to oust him, Nvidia's value reportedly fell over $1T, US security concerns and an investigation followed, Taiwan reportedly revoked the alleged spy's re-entry, and Beijing denied spying.

10.text: Micron’s AI memory demand, tight supply, buyback expansion, and analyst targets above $1,600 support a bullish outlook despite sharp volatility and a 30% pullback. Nvidia appears mainly as a sentiment driver, with Micron and SK hynix falling ahead of Nvidia’s earnings.

15.text: AI infrastructure spending forecasts rose to $800 billion for 2026 and $1.1 trillion for 2027, boosting Broadcom, AMD, TSMC, Micron and Nvidia. Broadcom, AMD, TSMC, Credo and Synopsys were framed as AI winners, with Broadcom favored and Nvidia facing pricing pressure.

8.text: The pieces cover ETF recommendations and comparisons—VOO, VUG, VONG, equal-weight and dividend funds—plus historical returns, fees, and S&P 500 concentration. Nvidia is barely mentioned; it matters only indirectly as a major S&P 500 holding affecting cap-weighted index exposure.

11.text: CoreWeave raised its 2026 revenue forecast to $13.3 billion and beat Q3 expectations, while Nebius beat on revenue and profit but fell about 17% on soft guidance, delayed capacity, and a $45 billion spending plan. Microsoft data center delays and Nvidia-related news weighed on neocloud stocks.

12.text: Michael Burry doubled his Nasdaq 100 puts and holds semiconductor ETF puts to 2027, warning AI chip values will fall fast. Nvidia faces scrutiny over chip alternatives, excess supply, and $176 billion in hidden depreciation, though new GPU rental data challenges his thesis.

6.text: AMD stock surged on a Meta 6-gigawatt GPU deal, a Google Cloud EPYC processor supply agreement, and a $2.5 billion Anthropic stake, with analysts upgrading the shares amid record data-center revenue. Nvidia's troubles are pushing hyperscalers to seek a second AI chip supplier, benefiting AMD.
